findings.text: blocking: The finite-marker regex omits lexical verbs, so "The density rises and the temperature falls" stays one claim although the brief requires clauses joined by a conjunction to be split and independently checked.

blocking: Math followed by another clause, as in "The density is $n<0$ and the temperature rises", passes the tail check as "The density is and the temperature rises" and can make a correct entry look unsupported.
